sources.interpretation: NIKL OpenDict sense 008 explicitly licenses 이다 following -어서. Examples 넘어서였다 and 나서이다 establish temporal and causal uses.
Official answer distinguishes nominal, adverbial and connective attachment senses of 이다.
Official answer confirms that 이다 is not restricted to nouns; it does not certify every proposed particle/clause attachment.

decisions: Keep 어서 as an Ending, never a nominalizing suffix or an inserted nominal lemma. Use copula.connective_seo provenance rather than nominalization for this boundary.
Apply existing auxiliary, derivational, irregular, honorific, explicit and omitted-copula rules. Preserve both lexical whole-word alternatives and component paths.
Do not extend generic nominalization or arbitrary quoted/connective/copula attachment. Bare adverbial copulas and broader particle-marked attachment still require separate review.
No source reviewed here establishes a categorical rejection of 따다+어+를+이다 in 딸이었던들. Preserve that existing hypothesis as an unjudged concern; the daughter reading is required separately.
